summary: A compact 'How it works': 3 or 4 numbered steps in a row of cards with large numerals (01, 02, 03) joined by a line that draws in as the row enters. Shorter than process-sticky; use it when the process fits in a sentence per step. Optional photo per step, shown as a rounded picture at the top of each card with the numeral sitting on its lower edge (the connector line is left out then); use a photo on every step or none.
